def check_graph_fast(edges, n=11):
    G = nx.Graph()
    G.add_nodes_from(range(n))
    G.add_edges_from(edges)
    conn = nx.node_connectivity(G)
    if conn < 4:
        return conn, None
    max_ind = 0
    for size in range(5, 0, -1):
        found = False
        for subset in combinations(range(n), size):
            is_ind = all(not G.has_edge(u, v) for u, v in combinations(subset, 2))
            if is_ind:
                max_ind = size
                found = True
                break
        if found:
            break
    return conn, max_ind
